abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 13.1 | 6.5 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 13.2 | 6.6 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 15.4 | 7.7 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.9 | 6.5 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 12.8 | 6.4 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 16.4 | 8.2 | 800 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
